description:
The 'order-management' project has architectural issues: the 'model' package depends on the 'service' package, creating circular dependencies (Model <-> Service). Your task is to refactor the code to break these cycles.

Specific issues:
1. 'Order.java' calls 'DiscountService' to calculate totals.
2. 'Customer.java' calls 'FormattingService' to format names.

Refactor the code so that NO class in 'com.example.order.model' imports anything from 'com.example.order.service'. You may move logic, extract methods, or change method signatures (e.g., passing values instead of calling services). Ensure the project still compiles and all 8 unit tests pass.
